title: realvirtual Open Digital Twin Format (rv-ODT)
description: Machine-readable specification of the realvirtual Open Digital Twin Format. Component data is carried per glTF node under extras.realvirtual. Where the human-readable specification.md and this file disagree, this file is normative. Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (see schema/LICENSE).

ComponentReference.description: Reference to a component or PLC signal on another glTF node, identified by its scene path. The 'path' field is the ONLY identity carried today; a stable node-id field may be added alongside it in a future minor version, in which case 'path' remains valid and consumers prefer the id when both are present.

path.description: Node path identifying the target, built from glTF node NAMES. NORMATIVE RULES. (1) Root inclusion: the path is absolute and STARTS AT the exported scene root node — the root's own name is the first segment, so a reference to the root itself is exactly that name and a reference to a same-named direct child is 'X/X'. The glTF scene object itself contributes no segment. (2) Separator: '/'. glTF node names may legally contain '/', but Three.js' GLTFLoader strips it from every name it loads (see rule 3), so a conforming path is unambiguously splittable on '/'; producers MUST NOT emit a name containing '/'. (3) Which name: the node's glTF name as written in the file (nodes[i].name), BEFORE any consumer-side transformation. Three.js in particular applies PropertyBinding.sanitizeNodeName (whitespace to '_', then the reserved characters [ ] . : / removed) and then appends a '_N' suffix to make names unique FILE-GLOBALLY. Neither the sanitization nor the dedup suffix belongs in this field. (4) Uniqueness: producers SHOULD ensure paths are unique within the file; where two nodes anywhere in the file share a name, producers SHOULD warn, because consumers that dedup names will break every path leading THROUGH such a node. (5) Consumer fallbacks, permitted in this order and no other: (a) exact match on the written path; (b) match after applying the consumer's own name transformation to the query (e.g. space to '_'); (c) match against a pre-transformation alias the consumer recorded for a node it renamed, including for that node's descendants; (d) unique proper-suffix match, i.e. a registered path ending in '/' + the query. A consumer MUST NOT resolve step (d) when more than one distinct target matches — it MUST report the ambiguity and treat the reference as unresolved rather than pick one. Steps (b) to (d) are tolerance for imperfect producers, not part of the contract: a conforming producer is resolved entirely by step (a).

Vector3.description: 3D vector. Coordinate convention per field: see the 'unityCoords' vocabulary keyword.

ActiveOnly.description: Connection-state gate: whether a component participates in simulation depending on the viewer's live-connection state.

Drive.description: Linear or rotational motion control along a local axis. The base Drive component.

Direction.description: Motion axis of the drive in Unity local coordinates; 'Virtual' drives no transform.

ReverseDirection.description: Set to true if the direction needs to be inverted.

Offset.description: Start offset of the drive from zero position in millimeters or degrees.

StartPosition.description: Start position of the drive in millimeters or degrees.

TargetSpeed.description: The target speed of the drive in millimeters per second (degrees per second for rotational drives).

Acceleration.description: The acceleration in millimeters per second squared.

UseAcceleration.description: If set to true the drive uses the acceleration.

UseLimits.description: If set to true the drive motion is limited to the range between LowerLimit and UpperLimit.

LowerLimit.description: Lower drive limit in millimeters or degrees.

UpperLimit.description: Upper drive limit in millimeters or degrees.

JogForward.description: Jog the drive continuously forward at TargetSpeed.

JogBackward.description: Jog the drive continuously backward at TargetSpeed.

TargetPosition.description: The destination position of the drive in millimeters or degrees.

Drive_Simple.description: Drive behavior: simple jog control with speed and directional bits plus feedback signals.

Speed.description: PLC output for the speed of the drive in millimeters per second; can be scaled by ScaleSpeed.

Accelaration.description: PLC output for the acceleration of the drive in millimeters per second squared; field name keeps the original C# spelling.

Forward.description: Signal to move the drive forward.

Backward.description: Signal to move the drive backward.

IsAtPosition.description: Signal for the current position of the drive in millimeters.

IsAtSpeed.description: Signal for the current speed of the drive in millimeters per second.

IsDriving.description: Signal is true while the drive is driving.

ScaleSpeed.description: Scale factor for the input and output speed and acceleration.

CurrentPositionScale.description: Scale factor for the current position feedback.

CurrentPositionOffset.description: Offset applied to the position feedback in millimeters.

ScaleFeedbackPosition.description: If true, applies scale and offset to the position feedback.

Drive_Cylinder.description: Drive behavior: two-position pneumatic/hydraulic cylinder with in/out command and end-position feedback.

MinPos.description: Minimum position of the cylinder in millimeters.

MaxPos.description: Maximum position of the cylinder in millimeters.

TimeOut.description: Time for moving out from minimum to maximum position in seconds.

TimeIn.description: Time for moving in from maximum to minimum position in seconds.

OneBitCylinder.description: If set to true only one bit controls the cylinder; when Out is false the cylinder moves in.

InvertOutputLogic.description: When true, inverts the Out/In signal logic (Out=false extends, Out=true retracts).

Out.description: Signal for moving the cylinder out.

In.description: Signal for moving the cylinder in.

IsOut.description: Signal is true when the cylinder is out or stopped by the Max sensor.

IsIn.description: Signal is true when the cylinder is in or stopped by the Min sensor.

IsMax.description: Signal is true when the cylinder is at the maximum position.

IsMin.description: Signal is true when the cylinder is at the minimum position.

IsMovingOut.description: Signal is true while the cylinder is moving out.

IsMovingIn.description: Signal is true while the cylinder is moving in.

Drive_Speed.description: Drive behavior: speed-controlled motion via PLC target-speed signal with speed/position feedback.

SignalTargetSpeed.description: Target (maximum) speed of the drive in millimeters per second.

SignalAcceleration.description: Acceleration of the drive in millimeters per second squared.

SignalCurrentSpeed.description: Signal for the current drive speed in millimeters per second.

SignalCurrentPosition.description: Signal for the current drive position in millimeters.

SignalIsDriving.description: Signal is true while the drive is driving.

TargetSpeed.description: Default target speed in millimeters per second when no signal is wired.

Acceleration.description: Default acceleration in millimeters per second squared when no signal is wired.

CurrentPositionScale.description: Scale factor for the current position feedback.

CurrentPositionOffset.description: Offset applied to the position feedback in millimeters.

ScaleFeedbackPosition.description: If true, applies scale and offset to the position feedback.

Drive_Gear.description: Drive behavior: slaves this node's Drive to a master Drive position with gear ratio and offset.

MasterDrive.description: Master drive which defines the position of this drive.

GearFactor.description: Gear factor between master and slave position.

Offset.description: Offset of the gear in millimeters.

Drive_FollowPosition.description: Drive behavior: directly follows a PLC position signal (no ramping) with position feedback.

Position.description: Signal (PLC output) for the commanded position of the drive.

CurrentPosition.description: PLC input for the current position of the drive (without offset and scaling).

Offset.description: Offset in millimeters added to the position signal.

Scale.description: Scale factor applied to the position value.

CurrentPositionScale.description: Scale factor for the current position feedback.

ScaleFeedbackPosition.description: If true, applies scale and offset to the position feedback.

Drive_DestinationMotor.description: Drive behavior: point-to-point positioning motor. Start command drives to a destination with speed/acceleration commands and rich feedback.

StartDrive.description: Start-to-drive signal; a value change starts motion towards Destination.

Destination.description: Destination position of the drive in millimeters.

TargetSpeed.description: Target (maximum) speed of the drive in millimeters per second.

Acceleration.description: Acceleration of the drive in millimeters per second squared.

IsAtPosition.description: Signal for the current position of the drive in millimeters.

IsAtSpeed.description: Signal for the current drive speed in millimeters per second.

IsAtDestination.description: Signal is true when the drive is at the destination.

IsDriving.description: Signal is true while the drive is currently driving.

CurrentPositionScale.description: Scale factor for the current position feedback.

CurrentPositionOffset.description: Offset applied to the position command and feedback in millimeters.

ScaleFeedbackPosition.description: If true, applies scale and offset to the position feedback.

Drive_PositionSwitch.description: Drive behavior: boolean output signal that is true while the drive position is inside configured areas.

OutputSignal.description: Output signal to the PLC; true when the drive position is inside any configured area (inverted when InvertAreas is true).

InvertAreas.description: If true, areas define false zones instead of true zones (inverts the output).

PositionOffset.description: Global offset in millimeters or degrees applied to the drive position before area checking.

Drive_ErraticPosition.description: Drive behavior: moves the drive to random (or alternating min/max) positions — demo/test motion.

MinPos.description: Minimum position of the range where the drive is allowed to move to, in millimeters.

MaxPos.description: Maximum position of the range where the drive is allowed to move to, in millimeters.

Speed.description: Speed of the drive in millimeters per second.

IterateBetweenMaxAndMin.description: If true the drive only iterates between MinPos and MaxPos; if false it moves to random positions.

SignalEnable.description: While this signal is true the drive moves to erratic positions; when unwired it is always enabled.

Sensor.description: Presence sensor. Collision mode uses AABB overlap; raycast mode casts a ray and reports MU hits.

UseRaycast.description: If true the sensor uses raycast mode instead of collider (AABB overlap) mode.

RayCastDirection.description: Raycast direction vector in Unity local coordinates (readers negate X in glTF space).

SensorOccupied.description: Boolean PLC input for the sensor signal; true when the sensor is occupied.

SensorNotOccupied.description: Boolean PLC input for the sensor; true when the sensor is NOT occupied.

AutoRay.description: Derives the ray beam from the node bounding box (naming-convention sensors).

PhysicsMode.description: If true and the sensor overlaps a physics zone, the sensor is physics-managed: collision mode uses a physics sensor collider (enter/leave events), raycast mode a physics raycast. Physics-managed sensors detect only physics-owned MUs; sensors that must detect kinematic MUs keep the default false.

Mode.description: Legacy mode string ('Raycast'/'Collision'); readers SHOULD convert it to UseRaycast when UseRaycast is absent.

TransportSurface.description: Conveyor surface that moves MUs along a direction at the referenced Drive's speed.

TransportDirection.description: Transport direction in Unity local coordinates, set by the Drive component at export (readers negate X in glTF space).

Radial.description: If true the surface transports radially around the drive axis (turntables).

TextureScale.description: Texture animation speed multiplier in texture units per meter.

HeightOffsetOverride.description: Manual override for the transport height offset in millimeters.

AnimateSurface.description: Enables texture animation to visualize surface movement.

DriveReference.description: Optional drive reference for special cases; normally empty to use the auto-detected parent drive.

Accumulate.description: If true MUs on this surface accumulate: each MU clamps its advance to the free distance up to the next MU in move direction (no penetration). Ignored on Radial surfaces.

MinGap.description: Minimum front gap in millimeters kept between accumulated MUs.

PhysicsMode.description: If true and the surface lies fully inside a physics zone, the surface runs in physics mode: a kinematic conveyor body carries MUs via friction and jams/stacking are simulated physically. Ignored on Radial surfaces (v1 exclusion) and when the deployment switch simulation.physicsSurfaceDefault is false.

Source.description: Spawns new MU (Movable Unit) instances at intervals or by distance to the last spawned MU.

AutomaticGeneration.description: Automatic generation of MUs when the last MU is farther than GenerateIfDistance from the source.

Interval.description: Interval in seconds between the generation of MUs; 0 disables interval generation.

GenerateIfDistance.description: Distance in millimeters from the source at which new MUs are generated.

PlaceOnTransportSurface.description: If true newly spawned MUs are placed onto the transport surface below the source.

ThisObjectAsMU.description: Name of the GameObject used as the MU prototype; defaults to this node when empty.

CollisionRoleForMUs.description: Collision role assigned to every MU spawned by this source. 'None' = spawned MUs take part in no collision check.

Spawn.description: Legacy spawn-mode hint consumed by the reference implementation's spawn-config derivation.

Sink.description: Destroys MUs that touch it. Carries no configuration fields in v1.

Grip.description: Gripper for pick-and-place: picks MUs in range on a pick signal and places them on a place signal.

GripRange.description: Search radius in millimeters for automatic MU detection when no sensor is assigned.

OneBitControl.description: If true a single signal controls the gripper (rising edge picks, falling edge places).

PlaceMode.description: Controls how MUs are released on place: Auto (context-dependent), Static (stays kinematic) or Physics (falls onto surface).

GripTargetSearchRadius.description: Search radius in millimeters for finding the nearest GripTarget on place.

PartToGrip.description: Sensor identifying the MU to be gripped; when empty, auto-detection uses GripRange.

GripTarget.description: Placement marker for precise MU positioning during Grip auto-place.

AlignPosition.description: If true the MU position is snapped to the GripTarget position when placed.

AlignRotation.description: If true the MU rotation is aligned to the GripTarget rotation when placed.

ConnectSignal.description: One-way signal bridge: copies the value of the referenced source signal onto this node's own signal.

ConnectedSignal.description: Source signal whose value is copied onto this node's own signal on every change.

Lamp.description: Signal lamp: drives the emissive color of its first child mesh from a PLC signal.

SignalLampOn.description: Bool signal driving the on state.

SingalLampFlashing.description: Bool signal driving the flashing state. Field name keeps the Unity spelling.

Intensity.description: HDR emission intensity multiplier applied to OnColor.

Flashing.description: Lamp flashes instead of holding steady.

Period.description: Flashing period in seconds; half on, half off.

LampOn.description: On state used when no signal is bound.

OnColor.description: Unity Color {r,g,b,a} (floats 0..1) for the lit state; read raw (no schema field type for colors).

EnergyChain.description: Turns a rigid CAD energy-chain (cable carrier) mesh into an animated chain: straight strand, half-circle bend travelling at half the follower speed, constant length. Drive axis, bend radius, link height and chain length are MEASURED from the CAD rest pose; every numeric field left at 0 means auto-calibrate.

Anchor.description: Node the fixed chain end is attached to (Unity: public Transform Anchor, wire componentType UnityEngine.Transform). Empty = auto. Shown read-only; corrected via web_editor_set_field.

Follower.description: Node the moving chain end (the carrier) is attached to. Empty = auto. Shown read-only; corrected via web_editor_set_field.

BendRadius.description: Centerline bend radius. 0 = measure from the rest pose.

ChainLength.description: Total centerline length. 0 = measure from the rest pose.

Axis.description: Travel axis in the chain-local frame. Auto = longest AABB extent.

BendUp.description: Moving strand runs above the fixed one. Flip when the measured assignment is upside down.

Bones.description: Bone count of the runtime rig. Clamped up to the minimum derived from the 15 deg linear-blend-skinning limit (21); the clamp is reported in the status line.

Enabled.description: Animate the chain. Off leaves it in the CAD rest pose.

CollisionRole.description: Collision role of this node's subtree. Bodies of different roles are checked against each other while the simulation runs; identical roles never collide.
Collision role of this node's subtree. Bodies of different roles are checked against each other; identical roles never collide. 'None' = not checked.

WebSensor.description: 3D-HMI marker: visualizes a bool or int signal as Low/High/Warning/Error states on the node.

SignalBool.description: Binary input: false = Low, true = High; use for 2-state sensors.

SignalInt.description: Integer input: value mapped to a state via IntStateMap; use for sensors with more states.

IntStateMap.description: Mapping of integer signal values to visual states, e.g. '0=Low;1=High;2=Warning;3=Error'.

Label.description: Optional label shown in the tooltip and sensor list.

WebDiagnostics.description: 3D-HMI marker: couples a PLC error signal to the AI error diagnosis; a rising edge triggers a diagnose request for this node.

SignalBool.description: Error signal: rising edge (false to true) triggers the diagnosis; falling edge clears it.

SignalInt.description: Error-code signal: any change to a non-zero value triggers the diagnosis with that code; 0 clears it.

DocFilter.description: Metadata filter passed to the diagnosis backend (machine, component or error-code range).

ErrorId.description: Stable error ID used as the key for the shared operator comment store; defaults to the node path.

Label.description: Optional human-readable label shown on the diagnosis card.

AutoOpen.description: If true the diagnosis dialog opens automatically on a rising edge; if false only the card is shown.

WebSafetyDoor.description: 3D-HMI marker: safety-door overlay with hazard-zone halo and floating label.

LabelHeight.description: Label position above the floor in millimeters.

WebPhysicsZone.description: Physics zone: 3D box volume inside which MUs are simulated as free dynamic rigid bodies (falling, sliding, tipping, stacking). Strictly opt-in — without this component no physics engine is loaded. The zone volume comes from the node's BoxCollider extras.

ZoneEnabled.description: Enables physics simulation inside this zone.

WholeScene.description: If true the box volume is ignored and the whole scene bounding box becomes the physics zone.

Friction.description: Default friction coefficient for MUs inside the zone.

Restitution.description: Bounciness of MUs inside the zone (0 = none).

RemoveBelowY.description: MUs falling below this world Y (meters) are removed.

ShowGizmo.description: Shows the zone as a wireframe box in the viewer.

StaticColliders.description: Node paths (string array) of additional static collision geometry (chutes, bins, machine frames); resolved via the node registry at zone build time; read raw (no string-array field type).

WebError.description: 3D-HMI marker: semantic error state bound to a bool signal, rendered as flashing highlight plus badge.

SignalError.description: Error signal: true = error active, false = OK; leave empty for a static hint marker.

ErrorText.description: Human-readable error message shown as 3D badge and in the message panel.

HighlightStyle.description: How the faulty part is highlighted: Auto (by part size), FlashObject or Circle. Writers MUST emit the named string; readers additionally accept the legacy integer index per the enumMap.

WebVisibility.description: 3D-HMI marker: shows/hides the node (and additional targets) from a bool signal; optionally carries an error state.

SignalVisible.description: Visibility signal: true = visible, false = hidden; leave empty to use DefaultVisible.

InvertSignal.description: If true the visibility signal logic is inverted (signal false = visible).

DefaultVisible.description: Visibility used when no visibility signal is bound.

AdditionalTargets.description: Optional additional objects (node references) that are shown/hidden together with this object.

SignalError.description: Error signal: true = error active (red, flashing), false = OK; leave empty for no error state.

ErrorText.description: Human-readable error message shown as 3D badge and in the message panel.

HighlightStyle.description: How the faulty part is highlighted: Auto (by part size), FlashObject or Circle. Writers MUST emit the named string; readers additionally accept the legacy integer index per the enumMap.

BlinkSpeed.description: Blink speed of the error highlight in Hz; higher is faster.

ErrorColor.description: Unity Color {r,g,b,a} (floats 0..1) for the error highlight; read raw (no schema field type for colors).

CustomRuntimeInstruction.description: 3D-HMI marker: operator instruction (info/maintenance/warning/error/success) bound to an activation signal.

type.description: Instruction category (Info, Maintenance, Warning, Error, Success). Writers MUST emit the C# enum name; readers map it to the lowercase internal value and additionally accept the legacy integer index per the enumMap.

dismissible.description: If true the operator can dismiss the instruction via an OK/close button (offered on the last step only). Once dismissed it reappears only on the next rising signal edge. If false the instruction stays until the signal goes low.

Isolate.description: realvirtual WEB only: when the operator clicks the message, the step's target objects are additionally isolated (rest of the scene dimmed) for a clearer view, on top of the camera focus and highlight.

signal.description: Activation signal; the instruction is shown while the signal is true.

BlinkSpeed.description: Blink speed of the attention highlight in Hz. 0 = no blinking, the part is only highlighted; higher = faster.

steps.description: Instruction steps: array of { instruction, targetObjects (array of node paths, highlighted in parallel), targetObject (legacy single node path), url }; read raw (nested object list).

ErrorColor.description: Unity Color {r,g,b,a} for the error highlight; read raw.

RuntimeMetadata.description: Tooltip/annotation content for an object. XML-like markup string.

content.description: XML-like annotation markup shown as tooltip content for the object.

IKPath.description: Robot inverse-kinematics path: ordered list of IKTarget references with start/end signals.

SpeedOverride.description: Speed override factor for this path.

SetNewTCP.description: Sets a new TCP (tool center point) for this path.

DrawPath.description: Draws the path in the scene view.

DrawTargets.description: Draws the targets in the scene view.

DebugPath.description: Debugs the path by drawing points.

DebugBlending.description: Logs detailed blending state transitions for debugging.

StartPath.description: Starts the path on simulation start.

LoopPath.description: Loops the path after it has ended.

SignalIsStarted.description: Signal that the path is started.

SignalEnded.description: Signal that the path has ended.

Path.description: Ordered list of IKTarget references forming the path.

StartNextPath.description: ComponentReference to the IKPath started when this path ends; read raw.

IKTarget.description: Robot inverse-kinematics target: pose plus interpolation, blending, signal and pick/place settings.

FollowInEditMode.description: If true the target follows the robot in edit mode.

SpeedToTarget.description: Speed to target as a factor of the axis speeds.

LinearAcceleration.description: Linear acceleration in millimeters per second squared.

InterpolationToTarget.description: Interpolation to the target: PointToPoint, PointToPointUnsynced or Linear.

LinearSpeedToTarget.description: Linear speed to the target in millimeters per second.

TurnCorrection.description: If true the robot applies the 180-degree turn correction of axes 4 and 6.

SetSignalDuration.description: Duration of the set signal in seconds.

WaitForSeconds.description: Wait time in seconds after the target is reached.

PickAndPlace.description: Enables pick/place handling at this target.

Pick.description: Picks with the assigned grip when the target is reached.

Place.description: Places with the assigned grip when the target is reached.

EnableBlending.description: Enables zone blending: the robot transitions to the next target at BlendRadius distance instead of stopping exactly at this target.

BlendRadius.description: Radius in millimeters of the blending zone around this target.

SetSignal.description: Signal set when the target is reached.

WaitForSignal.description: Signal to wait for after the target is reached.

AxisPos.description: Pre-computed joint-angle solution (number[6], degrees) serialized by the Unity IK solver; read raw.

gripTarget.description: ComponentReference to the Grip used for pick/place at this target; read raw.

fixer.description: ComponentReference to a Fixer used for pick/place (fallback when gripTarget is absent); read raw.

RobotIK.description: Robot inverse-kinematics solver configuration on the robot root node.

WristType.description: Wrist topology: Spherical (standard industrial robot, analytical solution) or NonSpherical (cobot with wrist offsets).

ElbowInUnityX.description: If true the elbow axis is oriented along Unity X.

CADLink.description: Pure metadata on an imported CAD root: original file reference plus import parameters. Enables CAD re-import.

File.description: Original CAD file name this subtree was imported from.

Sha256.description: Content hash of the original CAD file.

Quality.description: Tessellation quality preset used at import.

ImportScaleFactor.description: Scale factor applied at import (CAD units to meters).

ZIsUpVector.description: If true the CAD source used Z-up orientation.

JTData.description: CAD metadata read from a JT file by the rv-jt reader: part name, mass, source units, layer and the stable body uid. Pure import provenance - read-only, never hand-edited, and replaced (not merged) on CAD re-import. Every field is optional: the reader omits what the source file does not provide rather than emitting 0 or null.

ContractVersion.description: Version of the JTData contract this block was written with.

PartName.description: Part name from the CAD system (CAD_PARTNAME).

Mass.description: Mass of the part. The unit is not recorded in JT files and is therefore unknown.

MassSource.description: Where the mass came from: 'asserted' (user-set, assembly level) or 'cad' (computed, part level). These describe different objects and must not be summed.

SourceUnits.description: Length unit of the source model, raw - before the mm to m conversion the reader applies.

BodyUid.description: Stable per-body CAD uid, suitable for matching a part across revisions.

Pipe.description: Process-industry pipe segment: fluid resource, flow and instrumentation values for the 3D-HMI tooltip.

resourceName.description: Name of the fluid/resource flowing through the pipe.

flowRate.description: Current flow rate through the pipe.

source.description: Reference to the upstream component (tank, pump or pipe).

destination.description: Reference to the downstream component (tank, pump or pipe).

velocityMs.description: Flow velocity in meters per second.

Pump.description: Process-industry pump: flow, circuit assignment and instrumentation values for the 3D-HMI tooltip.

flowRate.description: Current flow rate delivered by the pump.

resourceName.description: Medium currently flowing through the pump.

speedRpm.description: Motor speed in revolutions per minute.

npshAvailable.description: Net positive suction head available in meters.

npshRequired.description: Net positive suction head required in meters.

ResourceTank.description: Process-industry tank: fluid resource, fill level and instrumentation values for the 3D-HMI tooltip.

density.description: Fluid density in kilograms per cubic meter.

agitatorOn.description: True while the mixer/agitator is running.

heatingOn.description: True while the jacket heater is on.

tempHighLimit.description: High temperature alarm limit in degrees Celsius; 0 = no alarm.

tempLowLimit.description: Low temperature alarm limit in degrees Celsius; 0 = no alarm.

pressureHighLimit.description: High pressure alarm limit in bar; 0 = no alarm.

ProcessingUnit.description: Production machine/station: OEE and production telemetry values for the 3D-HMI tooltip.

cycleTimeS.description: Current actual cycle time in seconds.

mtbfHours.description: Mean time between failures in hours.

mttrMinutes.description: Mean time to repair in minutes.

runHours.description: Run time in hours this period.

downHours.description: Down time in hours this period.

LogicStep_SerialContainer.description: LogicStep: sequential container — child nodes (in hierarchy order) execute one after another; the top-level container loops.

Active.description: Connection-state gate: whether this step participates depending on the live-connection state.

LogicStep_ParallelContainer.description: LogicStep: parallel container — child nodes execute concurrently; the container ends when all children ended.

Group.description: Named group membership of a node. Multiple Group entries per node are serialized as 'Group', 'Group1', 'Group2', ...

GroupName.description: Name of the group this node belongs to.

GroupNamePrefix.description: Scene path of a node whose name prefixes GroupName (resolved group name = prefixNode.name + GroupName). Shown when present in the GLB, never stamped on newly authored components.

Kinematic.description: Kinematic re-structuring directive (from the Unity Kinematic tool): re-parents group members under this node and/or re-parents this node under another node after load.

IntegrateGroupEnable.description: If true, top-level members of the named group are re-parented under this node after load.

GroupName.description: Group whose members are re-parented under this node.

GroupNamePrefix.description: Scene path of a prefix node (resolved group name = prefixNode.name + GroupName).

SimplifyHierarchy.description: If true only mesh nodes of the group are re-parented.

KinematicParentEnable.description: If true this node is re-parented under Parent after load.

Parent.description: Scene path of the new parent node.

MU.description: Movable Unit template marker. The node marked with MU is the template cloned by Source components. Carries no consumed configuration fields in v1.

BoxCollider.description: Axis-aligned collider volume in node-local space, used for sensors, transport surfaces, sources and sinks.

center.description: Collider center in Unity node-local coordinates (readers negate X in glTF space).

size.description: Absolute box dimensions in node-local units (no coordinate flip).

LayoutObject.description: Layout-planner marker on a placed library object.

Label.description: Display label of the placed object.

CatalogId.description: Library catalog id the object was placed from.

Locked.description: If true the object is locked against layout edits.

Splat.description: Gaussian-splat placement settings (axis inversion and local-frame crop box).

CropMinX.description: Local-frame crop box minimum X; splats outside the box are culled.

CropMinY.description: Local-frame crop box minimum Y (raise to hide floor noise).

CropMaxY.description: Local-frame crop box maximum Y (lower to hide ceilings).

AASLink.description: Asset Administration Shell link: connects the node to an AAS on a server.

Description.description: Optional description shown in the tooltip header.

ServerUrl.description: Optional AAS server URL; when empty the AASX is loaded from the local aasx/ folder.

WebComponent.description: JavaScript behavior component stored in the GLB: sandboxed script executed by the viewer's QuickJS runtime when scripting is enabled (trust gate).

Active.description: If false the component is parsed but never executed.

ApiVersion.description: Component-SDK contract version the code was written against.

Language.description: Source language of Code; stored code is always conservative JavaScript.

DesSafe.description: Author claim that the script uses only event-driven primitives (checked by the DES lint).

TypeId.description: Library/type identity for reuse, inspector display and statistics.

Code.description: JavaScript source following the global setup(self) contract; empty means no VM is created.

Path.description: WebViewer-native arc-length path (plan-268): a chain of line/arc segments for path-based movement (AGV/FTS, overhead conveyors). The structured fields — 'segments' (array of { kind:'line', from, to } | { kind:'arc', center, radius, startAngle, degrees, clockwise?, plane? }), 'successors' (string[] path-id graph edges), 'align' ([x,y,z] up vector, default [0,1,0]) and the 'type'/'id' discriminators — are parsed by parsePathExtras() in rv-path.ts (the executable TS-SSOT); only the scalar fields are listed here. Detection is coupled to this payload (inner type 'Path' or absent), never to node names.

version.description: Path schema version (migration anchor). Unknown versions parse best-effort with a warning.

closed.description: Circulating path (overhead conveyor / loop): arc-length addresses wrap modulo length.

DrivesRecorder.description: Playback settings for a recorded drive sequence.

PlayOnStart.description: If true playback starts automatically on simulation start.

ReplayStartFrame.description: First frame of the replay range.

ReplayEndFrame.description: Last frame of the replay range; 0 = to end.

Active.description: Connection-state gate: controls playback in connected/disconnected mode.

DrivesRecording_compact.description: Compact drive recording: flat position array indexed as positions[frame * driveCount + driveIndex].

fixedDeltaTime.description: Fixed timestep of the recording in seconds.

drives.description: Array of { id, path } drive descriptors.

sequences.description: Optional array of { name, startFrame, endFrame } named sequences.

positions.description: Flat drive positions array indexed as positions[frame * driveCount + driveIndex].

ReplayRecording.description: Signal-triggered replay of a named sequence from a DrivesRecording.

Sequence.description: Name of the sequence inside the recording to replay.

StartOnSignal.description: Bool signal that starts the replay on a rising edge.

IsReplayingSignal.description: Bool signal set true while the replay is running.

Active.description: Connection-state gate: controls replay in connected/disconnected mode.

Connections.description: Typed, directed connections between components (plan-259). Carried once per scene (typically on the root node) under extras.realvirtual.Connections. A connection is a named bidirectional call: the source invokes the target with request parameters, the target answers (usually deferred) with response parameters.

connections.description: Flat edge list (serialization truth; adjacency is a runtime index). 1:n fan-out/fan-in via repeated source/target paths.

connectionTypes.description: User-defined connection type signatures. Built-in types (StopOnExit) are registered in code and need no entry.

RvConnection.description: One directed connection edge between two nodes, identified by scene paths.

id.description: Stable edge id, unique within the scene.

source.description: Slash-separated node path of the source (caller) end.

target.description: Slash-separated node path of the target (callee) end.

type.description: Connection type name — built-in (StopOnExit) or user-defined via connectionTypes.

config.description: Type-specific per-edge configuration, e.g. { ProcessTime: 3.0 } for StopOnExit.

ConnectionType.description: User-defined connection type signature: request/response parameter schemas. Makes a GLB self-describing — the viewer renders typed inspector fields and validates call parameters without any code.

request.description: Request parameter schema: parameter name to wire type (bool | int | float | string).

response.description: Response parameter schema: parameter name to wire type (bool | int | float | string).
